_templateNotes: Copy this file to a new label file such as lateral_raise_001.json, then edit the paths, split, expectedReps, and reps.
Use issueIds from availableIssues. Use an empty issueIds array for a clean rep.
Files named _template.json or *.template.json are ignored by dataset:evaluate and dataset:optimize.

reps.notes: Clean rep or describe the visible form issue.

notes: Draft label template. Copy to a real label file, review timings/issues, then set reviewStatus to reviewed.

availableIssues.feedbackMessage: Raise higher — aim for shoulder level.
Stop around shoulder height — avoid lifting too high.
Keep your arms straighter — avoid excessive elbow bend.
Stay upright — avoid swaying or leaning.
Even it out — raise both arms to the same height.
Raise out to your sides — avoid turning it into a front raise.
Lift with control — avoid swinging the weights up.
Control the descent — lower the weights slowly.
Relax your traps — don't shrug the weight up.
